mentions.name: Car Maintenance Tracking Web App
mentions.description: This web app tracks car maintenance history and includes SSO integration via Google OAuth. It covers the features the builder wanted from paid alternatives, with planned additions including notifications and an export mechanism for history data including file attachments.
mentions.problem: Paid alternatives did not offer all the features needed for tracking car maintenance.
mentions.audience: Personal car owner tracking their own vehicle's maintenance history
mentions.source_excerpt: I got most of my must-haves for my car maintenance tracking web app out of the way. it already does everything I wanted all the paid alternatives to do, even has SSO integration (only Google OAuth for now).

evidence.value: I got most of my must-haves for my car maintenance tracking web app out of the way. it already does everything I wanted all the paid alternatives to do, even has SSO integration (only Google OAuth for now).
